svg.title: DevOps AI Assistant on AWS — Architecture
svg.desc: Proposed AWS architecture for an agentic DevOps assistant. Includes a RAG ingestion pipeline, FastAPI and LangGraph workloads on EKS, scoped operational tools, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Bedrock, human change review, delivery and cross cutting operational controls.
svg.text: Agentic RAG for incident investigation, pipeline troubleshooting and infrastructure guidance
Authorize requests • submit and poll jobs
Knowledge refresh is a separate workflow.
Source versions and access scope are retained.
Prepare a patch or GitOps change
Operational reads are scoped to the caller.
Document chunks and vectors • source metadata • job results • durable LangGraph checkpoints
Knowledge versions • conversation state • project and environment access filters
Reviewed changes enter the delivery pipeline
IAM • RBAC • Secrets Manager • KMS • ACM
Custom RAG baseline • Logical service view • Return paths omitted • OpenSearch and DynamoDB are optional later extensions
